payload.text: 3.3.0, THE ONE NEXT RELEASE (hv directive 1, decision 109). OWED BY hv, in the order vc would take them: the answer on client names (watchout 34), which the push waits on and which gets dearer with each commit; the ratification of ST0092's terms document on twelve points (todo 76); which remotes a cut pushes to (watchout 33; built as local and upstream meanwhile); whether Intent keeps an AT's own red-then-green on the code as it was; and the shape of issue 0665. 3.3.0 ALSO WAITS ON DEVBIN'S NEXT RELEASE, which hv fires: it carries the pre-flight seam and the release commit's trailer (decision 113, todo 71), and it is swept into Intent's tree before the cut. WHERE THE LANES STAND, each seat directed by vc on hv's word of 2026-11-10 (decision 111). cc: holds for the ratification (its hold 35), with its notes on the hand form taken into WP-06 and WP-07. dc: ST0091/01 and ST0091/04 are WIP and claimed; it builds WP-04's trigger change first and then WP-01's project commands, to vc's rulings (decision 112); then WP-02 and WP-03, issue 0670 in the shape its record carries, issue 0665 once hv has ruled its shape, and issue 0649, measured first. ic: issue 0661 is claimed and building in tmp/wt-ic-0661, on vc's shape ruling of 2026-11-10, which the issue's record carries; then 0650, 0672 in the full shape (todo 75), 0676 and 0677, and for ST0092 each of cc's surface rows and WP-10. THE PUSH: hold 8. BEFORE THE CUT: Devbin's next release is swept in; hv says which remotes the cut pushes to and release.remotes is declared (watchout 33); hv sees ST0090's row on a 3.3.0 build (hold 6); every package and issue above is landed and its gate read. THE CUT is hv's, once. AFTER IT: ST0092's sweep. Every heavy run is booked with the estate's controller, agentic-engineering-vc. Its measured figures for Intent, all of 2026-11-10: a one-module run from a warm target 15 seconds, an incremental rebuild with three arms 16 seconds, cold builds of intentd and the CLI 32 and 19 seconds, and the whole-suite judge 6 minutes.
